authorization: Standing user permission (2026-10-17) for needed Sonnet 5.5 medium subscription sessions; user asked to run this on 2026-10-20. No API fallback.

readout_per_turn: declared_closure.declared: completion row for the tests declaration
declared_closure.delivery: state (unobserved/intent/emitted), intents, emitted, follow-up state
native.native_runner_adoption: completed owned runner call with a fresh owned receipt in the native session
independent_grade: cumulative passing groups (4/6/8/10 expected for full correctness)

frozen_outcome_definitions.owned_path_after_feedback: a turn at or after the first emitted turn has native_runner_adoption true, or a delivery follow-up other than unobserved
frozen_outcome_definitions.non_adoption: feedback emitted and no owned runner adoption in any turn at or after it
frozen_outcome_definitions.no_feedback: no turn reads emitted; the question is then unanswered, not negative

retention: Every outcome is retained, including timeout, non-adoption and missing emission. No favorable retry, case replacement or human candidate repair.
limits: One authored JavaScript case and one conversation: an observation, not a rate.
A later owned receipt is temporal correlation; it does not establish that the model read the feedback.
Python is not scheduled: a filtered python -m unittest run produces no generic record, so feedback cannot fire there at this runtime.
No ordinary arm and no coding-quality or speed comparison.
